concept:
Use case: logo-brand. Design exploration sheet for a premium Android launcher icon for Squish Compressor, a private photo/video compression app. Create a polished 1536x1024 horizontal visual presentation with THREE equally sized clearly separated icon concepts, left to right, on a softly tinted blue backdrop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, watermarks.
All concepts: bold compact central composition on a royal blue square icon field, liquid-glass and jelly material, soft cyan refraction and pale blue (never white) specular highlights, extremely readable at 48px, no zip/archive symbols, no pure white or pure black. Palette #2D63F5, #3A9BFF, #2CCBE0 with tiny warm coral accent if helpful.
LEFT: a single pinched media tile. Thick softly rounded glass photo frame with its left and right sides gently pressed inward, giving the frame a distinctive narrow waist. Within it just one broad luminous mountain/play-like triangular shape and tiny warm sun. Elastic compressed but intact, delightful. No arrows. Front-on nearly flat, strong silhouette.
CENTER: two translucent blue photo/video tiles elegantly merging into one small intact bright tile; larger rear ghost frame fades while smaller solid front frame stays crisp. Clean geometric icon, no arrows or particles.
RIGHT: a broad circular liquid-glass lens with two inward-facing chunky rounded wedges surrounding a tiny intact media tile in the center. The wedges imply shrinking, balanced symmetry, fewer shapes.
Each concept must feel like a crafted premium app icon rather than a product photograph; restrained bevels, controlled highlights, beautiful simple geometry, no extraneous floating decoration. Show the three concepts large enough to evaluate.
final:
Use case: logo-brand / precise-object-edit. The input is a THREE-concept exploration sheet. Use ONLY the LEFT concept as the design reference and refine it into the FINAL standalone transparent Android adaptive-icon FOREGROUND for Squish Compressor.
Draw one bold pinched media tile, straight-on front view: a softly rounded almost-square liquid glass photo frame whose left and right sides gently bend INWARD at their midpoints, like a delightful elastic jelly tile being compressed but staying intact. Top and bottom gently concave too, corner lobes soft and round, beautiful strong symmetric silhouette. Thin carefully controlled luminous pale-cyan glass rim and smooth wide cyan-blue bevel, not an overblown white rim. Interior transparent blue glass, rich bright blue optical depth. Inside: ONLY one large simple rounded triangular cyan mountain / media glyph rising from lower left-center, and one small warm peach-coral sun in the upper right. Remove the second mountain. The single broad triangle is the media cue and must remain perfectly intact. No play-arrow cutout, no actual arrows, no hands or squeezing plates, no extra dots, no outer droplet.
Premium Apple-like liquid glass, restrained specular highlight along upper-left rim, gentle refraction, sharp clean edges, a little tactile dimensionality without a photographic perspective. Bright cyan and periwinkle rim against royal blue interior. Palette #2D63F5, #3A9BFF, #2CCBE0 with highlights #D5F4FF and small accent #FFB69D. Never pure white, never pure black.
IMPORTANT production asset: real transparent alpha outside the one tile. NO blue background tile, NO square icon plate, NO opaque backdrop, NO surrounding glow, NO cast shadow outside object, NO ground plane, NO checkerboard. Isolate just the pinched glass object. Square 1024x1024 canvas with the object centered and filling about 80 percent of the canvas, generous transparent margins. No text, letters, numerals, symbols, labels, watermark. Must read beautifully at 48px.
